description.html: The 40x20x30 cm terrarium is long and shallow: 800 cm² of floor, 30 cm of height and 24 liters of volume. The 20 cm depth, part of which is taken up by the 3D background, means it fits on a narrow shelf or a windowsill out of direct sun. It is ventilated through mesh.

Forty centimeters of length is enough to clearly separate a warm and a cool side for juveniles. A juvenile corn snake uses the length and climbs the background. Young crested and gargoyle geckos do well with 30 cm of height and a branch set at an angle. For a leopard gecko the floor is narrow, so use it only for rearing.

The same length with a 5 cm wider floor exists as the 40x25x30. If your shelf allows it, we recommend the wider variant. We build any combination to order, with a lead time of 7 to 14 days. When ordering you choose both the pattern of the outer film and the shape of the background.
